data.name: Haarith
data.gender_notes: Haarith is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name of the companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who was known for his guidance and leadership. The name Haarith carries the meaning “Guiding Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haarith usually hope their child will grow to embody guiding light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Quranic verse 13:11, 'And We have certainly honored the children of Adam...'
data.etymology: Haarith belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guiding Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haarith total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: حارث
in_arabic.meaning: حارث هو من يحفر الأرض أو من يزرع ويغرس
in_arabic.long_meaning: حارث هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه من يحفر الأرض أو من يزرع ويغرس، ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف آية 10 'وَأَرَّثَ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ رَبْعًا'، و الحارث هو الشخص الذي يقوم بزراعة الأرض وتهيئتها للزراعة، و هو من الأسماء ذات الأصول العريقة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: حارث
in_urdu.meaning: حارث کا مطلب ہے زمین کھودنے والا یا کاشت کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حارث ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے زمین کھودنے والا یا کاشت کرنے والا، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة یوسف میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم نام ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان

in_hindi.name: हारिथ

in_pashto.name: حارث
in_pashto.meaning: حارث د ځمکې د کیندلو یا د کښت کولو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حارث د عربي نوم دی چې د ځمکې د کیندلو یا د کښت کولو معنی لري، دا نوم د قرآن کریم په سورت یوسف کې ذکر شوی دی، او دا د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره یو مهم نوم دی

in_english.name: Haarith
in_english.meaning: One who digs the earth or plants and cultivates
in_english.long_meaning: Haarith is a masculine Arabic name meaning 'one who digs the earth or plants and cultivates'. It originates from the Arabic root 'ḥ-r-th' which relates to digging, cultivating, or plowing the land. The name is mentioned in the Quran (Surah Yusuf, verse 10) and holds significant cultural and spiritual importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing diligence, hard work, and a connection to the land

data.cultural_impact: The name Haarith is of Arabic origin, carrying a rich cultural heritage in Islamic history. Haarith was a renowned Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who played an instrumental role in spreading the message of Islam. His legendary bravery, leadership qualities, and unwavering devotion to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) are celebrated among the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Haarith can be seen as a symbol of guidance and leadership. He is an embodiment of the attributes that Muslims should strive to embody - strength, courage, unwavering faith, and dedication to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his message. The name Haarith can serve as a reminder and inspiration for individuals to follow the path of truth and righteousness, as Haarith did, even in the face of adversity. This spiritual significance resonates deeply within the Islamic community and is reflected in the naming of children with this name.
